title: Vision Plans Reinstatement After a Nonpayment Termination
content:
**Reinstatement terms — Vision Plans**

Vision coverage may be reinstated only if it was terminated for nonpayment and the reinstatement is made no later than the reinstatement window after the termination date of the vision enrollment.

- *Window:* the plan's reinstatement window days (30), counted in calendar days from the termination date; the last day of the window is in time.
- *Record relied on:* the enrollment's termination date and termination reason, for that enrollment.
- *Billing state:* reinstatement is carried out only after the funding billing account has been reinstated to active. This is read from the status of the Premium Billing Accounts account that funds the enrollment.
- *Effect:* coverage then continues without a gap, and services denied as not eligible in the gap are reprocessed.
- *Other reasons:* coverage ended for any other reason cannot be reinstated.

| Termination reason | Reinstated on | Funding account status | Reinstatement |
|---|---|---|---|
| Nonpayment, terminated 31 March (hypothetical) | 30 April (30th day) | Active | Allowed |
| Nonpayment, terminated 31 March (hypothetical) | 1 May (31st day) | Active | Not allowed (window passed) |
| Nonpayment, within the window | — | Not yet reinstated to active | Not yet carried out |
| Voluntary, loss of eligibility or group terminated | — | — | Not available |
